title: Debug mode enabled in application code — review required
description: A debug flag is set to true (Flask app.run(debug=True), Django DEBUG = True, or similar). Debug mode exposes tracebacks, an interactive console, or verbose errors to anyone who can reach the service. This lexical rule flags the assignment; the reviewer confirms it never ships to production.
remediation: Read the debug flag from an environment variable that defaults to false, and fail startup when debug is true outside local development. Strip debug toolbars and console routes from production builds.
limitation: Lexical: matches debug=true assignments only; a flag read from config files or set through frameworks this pattern misses is out of scope. Non-production test scaffolding matches too.
